coverage.title: AI agents, inside your neobank
copy: Give your users one API key for the top AI models, at network prices, paid from the
balance they already hold with you.
A partner brief for onchain neobanks

coverage.title: Your users already pay for AI. Somewhere else.
copy: Part 1 · The opportunity Your users already pay for AI. Somewhere else.
AI is a line item now Chat subscriptions and AI tools show up on card statements every month, at a merchant that isn't you.
Agents pay by the request Agents don't buy subscriptions. They call APIs all day, and each one needs a key and a balance to pay from.
You hold the balance Your users keep stablecoins with you. Today that money leaves your app to pay for AI. It doesn't have to.

coverage.title: Add AI agents to your app. In three moves.
copy: Part 1 · The opportunity Add AI agents to your app. In three moves.
Plus: the usage you bring earns you $ANTS rewards. Keep them, or pass them on as more cashback.
700+ models through one API: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and more.
Providers compete on price, so your users pay less than the lab.
Cashback, tiers or points on AI spend: a reason to keep the money in your app.

coverage.title: Good for your users. Better for your bank.
copy: Part 1 · The opportunity Good for your users. Better for your bank.
A daily habit, not a monthly one
A card gets opened at checkout. Agents run every day, and every request is paid from your app.
"Half back on AI agents" is a headline. It gives prosumers a reason to choose you.
A reason to move up a tier
Stack AI cashback on top of your tiers, and pay more back to your best customers.
Usage earns you $ANTS rewards. Keep them, or turn them into more cashback.
Agents need a key and a balance to pay from. You hold the balance; Antseed brings the key.
No lock-in to one AI provider
700+ models through one API. When a better model ships, your users have it the same day.

coverage.title: Network prices, then your reward.
copy: Part 1 · The opportunity Network prices, then your reward.
Antseed lowers the price before your reward even starts. A 50% cashback on top takes Claude Opus 5.5 from $4.00 to $0.84 per million input tokens.
Effective cost under list price, with 50% cashback, on the five model families Solid offers −75–95%

coverage.title: Every request earns ANTS. You decide where they go.
copy: Part 1 · The opportunity Every request earns ANTS. You decide where they go.
The AI usage you bring to the network earns $ANTS rewards. They are yours: a second revenue line on top of the reward you offer.
Hold the ANTS as your own margin on AI usage.
Fund more cashback, bigger tier perks or launch promos.
Or mix the two Your rewards, your rules. Change the split whenever you like.

coverage.title: Like BitTorrent, but for AI.
copy: Part 2 · How it works Like BitTorrent, but for AI.
Your device finds providers over Mainline DHT, the same network BitTorrent uses, talks to them directly, and pays per request. Nobody sits in the middle.
Cards: lowest paid input price and providers · AntSeedStats · read 13 Nov 2026 · CC BY 4.0
Providers compete on price, so you pay less than the lab
Every response signed and checked against the model fingerprint
If one provider goes down, your request moves on to another

copy: Part 2 · How it works An API key for every customer.
Deploy your own endpoint with the Antseed Gateway and give each customer, and each of their agents, their own API key.
